name: UGC 477 (Hubble)
blurb: UGC 477, a low surface brightness galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ugc00477-hubble
story: UGC 477 is a low surface brightness galaxy, lying just over 110 million light-years away in the constellation of Pisces. Most of its matter is hydrogen gas rather than stars, and dark matter appears to dominate it.

claims.text: UGC 477 is a low surface brightness (LSB) galaxy
It lies just over 110 million light-years away in Pisces
Most matter in LSB galaxies is hydrogen gas rather than stars
UGC 477 appears to be dominated by dark matter
UGC 477 is an LSB galaxy targeted by program 10550
